description: This is a Java service class 'AuthorService' in a Spring Boot application, responsible for managing CRUD operations for the 'Author' entity via an 'AuthorRepository'. It includes methods for finding by ID, retrieving all authors, saving, deleting, and counting authors.

classes.name: AuthorService
classes.description: Service layer component providing CRUD operations for Author entities.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an author by their unique identifier, returning an Optional<Author>.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all authors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a new or existing author to the repository.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of author records.
